scope: Deployment engineering on frozen synthetic inputs only
diagnostic_selection: Highest FP32 top score among changed hypotheses, largest probability drift, then largest Unicode-case drift; deduplicate identical text/indicator pairs
candidate_1: All 36 linear MatMuls; per-channel signed INT8 with reduce_range=true to isolate documented U8S8 saturation risk
candidate_2: Same range-reduced quantization, retaining in FP32 the two encoder blocks ranked highest by normalized local error on at most three frozen diagnostic inputs
candidate_3: Quantize only the single linear MatMul ranked lowest in normalized local error, with every other node FP32
ranking: Maximum RMS(local ideal quantized output minus FP32 output) / RMS(FP32 output) across diagnostic inputs; block score is maximum node score; deterministic name tie-break
acceptance: Exact token/mask, NLI maxima/tie, review outcome, evidence, abstention, deterministic-label and gate parity on the unchanged full 24-case suite against both FP32 baselines
numerical_drift: Descriptive only; no relaxed numerical decision thresholds
failure_action: Stop after three candidates; retain canonical FP32 ONNX; preserve failed candidates as experimental
